Molded plastic case resembling an attaché case, with an outer surface of plastics, falls under heading 4202.12 (briefcases, attaché cases and similar containers). Heading 4202 covers containers similar to briefcases, so this case qualifies as a similar container under 4202.12. The relevant subheadings are:
- 4202.12.20: outer surface of plastics, structured, rigid on all sides.
- 4202.12.80: other.

CBP rulings on such cases have classified them under 4202.12.2020 (or 4202.12.2080), "trunks, suitcases, vanity cases... of plastics, structured, rigid on all sides." Under 4202.12.20 the statistical suffixes are:
- .20: suitcases.
- .40: briefcases.
- .80: other.

Several CBP rulings on tool cases (e.g., NY N245542) state that because the case is similar to a briefcase or attaché case, it falls under 4202.12.2080 ("other"). I'm working from memory rather than the ruling text, so the exact suffix is my best recollection rather than confirmed.

{"hts_code": "4202.12.2080", "reason": "The case is a briefcase-like container with an outer surface of molded plastic, structured and rigid on all sides, and its insert is not fitted to specific contents, so it falls under 4202.12.20 as 'other'."}
